title: Internal: booking the final detention line of a container record
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, every per-container record whose clocks have all stopped is closed out with its final charges. This entry covers the final **detention** line of such a record and the internal tool the desk uses to book it.

## When it applies

Once the last clock of a record has stopped, its final detention line is booked with the detention days used beyond free time, the first and last detention day billed, and the amount.

## Business effect of the booking

- A new detention invoice entry dated today is written on the record, with the detention days billed, the first and last detention day covered and the amount.
- The amount is added to the balance the billed party owes on the record, and the record shows as invoiced.
- The entry is import detention for an import record and export detention for an export record.
- The customer can then see the detention line and the higher balance on the record.

## How it is invoked

The tool is **book_detention_invoice_dba94f21**. It is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock, through unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then called (call, through call_agent_discoverable_tool) by the agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| dnd_id | Reference number of the free-time record being invoiced, as returned by the free-time record lookup | identifier |
| chargeable_days | Detention days billed beyond free time | integer, calendar days |
| period_start_date | First detention day covered by the line | YYYY-MM-DD |
| period_end_date | Last detention day covered by the line | YYYY-MM-DD |
| amount_usd | Detention amount of the line | USD, a positive figure given to 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent before it is passed |

## Return

On success the tool answers with a confirmation of the form "Detention invoice line (invoice reference) booked on record (record reference): (days) day(s) from (start) to (end), USD (amount); balance due now USD (balance)." The invoice reference is the identifier customers quote for this line, and the balance is the record's outstanding amount in USD to 2 decimal places after the line. A message starting with "Error:" means no record exists under that reference and nothing was booked.

## Contract questions

**Q: Which date does the new detention entry carry?**
A: Today's date; the first and last detention days covered are carried separately in the two period parameters.

**Q: Does the tool itself decide the detention days or the amount?**
A: No. It books the days, dates and amount passed to it.
